name: Modified FOLFOX-6

eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.13 footnote

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.13 footnote

drugs.name: OXALIplatin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123733): Oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 over 2 hr, day 1 only.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.route: IV, concurrently with oxaliplatin (may be given via Y-connector)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123733): LV 400 mg/m2 concurrently with oxaliplatin, day 1.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123734): 5-FU bolus 400 mg/m2, day 1, following oxaliplatin/LV.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., Table 40.13 (line 123735): 5-FU 1,200 mg/m2/d x 2 d (2,400 mg/m2 total infusion over 46-48 hr) beginning day 1.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: moderate emetogenic risk tier (oxaliplatin) per NCCN Chemotherapy Order Template Appendix D - Antiemesis guideline prophylaxis for moderate emetic risk IV agents

G-CSF: FOLFOX-based regimens are generally low febrile-neutropenia risk; per NCCN Appendix C, low-risk regimens are not assigned a specific FN risk designation on the Template - prophylactic CSF not routinely recommended, consider per patient-specific factors

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle - platinum agent
neurologic assessment for oxaliplatin-related peripheral neuropathy

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

provenanceNote: Textbook-grounded draft. NCCN per-disease Chemotherapy Order Template appendices C, D, F, G referenced only for supportive-care sourcing; per-disease NCCN treatment guideline and hospital/institutional approval pending. Source table (DeVita Table 40.13) lists mFOLFOX-6 in the metastatic colorectal cancer setting citing Wolmark et al. 2009; mFOLFOX-6 is also widely used as adjuvant therapy in clinical practice, so both intents are listed pending explicit per-disease NCCN template confirmation. VERIFY-resolution (ONCQIS Wave-1 batch 1): histology resolved to adenocarcinoma per DeVita 12th ed. Chapter 40 (line 121516, colorectal adenocarcinoma; Histologic Type section line 121080). eligibilityCriteria resolved to good performance status with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function per DeVita Table 40.13 footnote (line 123747) and the metastatic-disease entry-criteria preamble (lines 123415 to 123420). treatmentSetting and stage kept VERIFY because DeVita establishes modified FOLFOX-6 as the basis for both adjuvant and metastatic FOLFOX trials (lines 122910 to 122911), so a single setting/stage is not source-determined. lineOfTherapy kept VERIFY (not stated for this regimen). biomarkers kept VERIFY because the FOLFOX cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-gated in DeVita. evidence.core evidenceStatus set to unknown (long-lived textbook framework, no current-guideline currency confirmation).
